name: Constant-Time Authentication Signature Guard
prompt: verify.js exports verifySignature(payload, signature, secret), which checks a hex HMAC-SHA256 signature of payload. It compares strings with ===, which leaks timing. Fix it: compare with crypto.timingSafeEqual, check lengths first, and return false (never throw) when the signature is the wrong length, is not valid hex, or is not a string. Keep the same name and export. Commit your change.
